name: 92627 · Costa Mesa, CA
findings: ZIP 92627 (Costa Mesa) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92627 (Costa Mesa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
